messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - runtime-prod gpu pool: container restarts observed on node gpu-18. OOM during prefill (long prompt). Instances restarting ~every 30s. auto-escalate=on.
Joan (oncall): seeing the same in logs, prefill spikes then cudaOOM in liveness probe. kicking off triage.
Rahul: can we cordon gpu-18 and drain in place? suspect noisy long-context job.
Joan (oncall): cordon started: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-18 --context prod`
Ops-Bot: drain queued: `kubectl drain gpu-18 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (progress 12/20 pods)
Sam: initiating quick mitigation: apply prefix-trim policy for requests >= 80k tokens to drop to 8k. pushing policy flag to runtime-configs/overflow.
Maria: routing update: shifting traffic for model:redwood-large -> model:redwood-medium for affected routes (canary). This reduces memory by ~45% but may raise latency.
Joan (oncall): started kvcache eviction on live nodes to free ~12GB: `runtimectl cache evict --pool gpu --age 0s`
Rahul: looking at stacktrace: `cuda: out of memory at allocate 2147483648` tied to prefill size. also see repeated container restarts causing backoff.
Maria: customer-ops: pinged affected customers. initial impact: ~1.8% error rate on generate endpoints in us-west. providing ETA 30m.
Customer-ops: notified AcmeCorp and BetaApps via status page and sent follow-up email; they reported intermittent failed requests and some retries succeeded.
Sam: temp config pushed: `prefill.max_tokens=16384` -> `prefill.max_tokens=8192` on prod-gateway for routing group alpha. will observe.
Joan (oncall): after cordon/drain, drained 18/20 pods; last 2 stuck in restart loop due to eviction failures, force-deleteing now.
Ops-Bot: node gpu-18 marked unschedulable, autoscaler provisioning replacement nodes (expected +2)
Rahul: finding offending job: large_batch_ingest from partner pipeline spiking. throttled their token rate at ingress (rate-limit 0.5 rps for large messages).
Maria: rolled fallback policy across 60% of traffic for the next 15m. metrics show prefill memory use trending down.
Joan (oncall): container restarts dropped to 0 in the last 90s on previously impacted nodes. moving to stabilization.
Sam: reminder - we need a hotpatch to trim overlong prefill instead of crash. opening PR with guard rails.
Rahul: next steps: postmortem, add kvcache eviction automation on prefill-OOM signal, consider circuit breaker per-tenant for >X tokens.
Maria: customer update drafted, will send 30m post stabilization. include workaround (reduce context, use smaller model, increase retries with backoff).
Joan (oncall): passing to night oncall at 3923457000, add to incident log, attach traces. thanks team :thumbsup:
Ops-Bot: incident record created: INC-3923456789 - prefills causing GPU OOM -> container restarts. severity P1 -> mitigated.
Joan (oncall): closing oncall thread, will follow up with blameless postmortem in #postmortems with timeline and action items.
